layout: Left column groups all inputs into labeled sections (Current details, Contributions, Retirement info, Return & tax projection) with a Reset per group, while the full right side is one large chart showing high/expected/low projection bands.
take: Group related sliders/fields under short section headers instead of one long list, so the single hero chart stays uncluttered and clearly the focus.

layout: Two-panel card: left has one slider driving a single bold headline number plus a short 'Expected Results' list, right shows the resulting plan/price as a secondary confirmation panel.
take: Limit the hero to one giant number tied directly to the slider, and push everything else (results list, plan card) to supporting, smaller text.

layout: Two key output stats pinned at top as the hero, three vertically stacked sliders directly below as secondary controls, and a live chart beneath that visualizes the same outputs.
take: Put the outcome numbers above the sliders (not beside, in a separate zone) so the result is the first thing read, with controls and chart as clearly separated secondary tiers.

layout: Hero is the single large net-worth projection line chart with one key stat callout, tabs above switch metric views, and a 'compare scenarios' plus plain-language summary sit as secondary panels below/beside.
take: Use one dominant chart with a single callout stat as the hero, and demote scenario comparison and explanatory text to a collapsible secondary strip so the main view stays glanceable.
